visualQA.reviewMethod: All 39 before/after SVG district maps inspected in four full contact sheets; Fatih additionally inspected full-size.

aggregate.performanceNote: Wall time includes local development activity; peak RSS is a sampled in-process maximum, not a controlled benchmark.

notes: Repository ADM2 source calls Adalar Prince Islands; expected 39 district identities match.
No approved official or verified OSM administrative ADM3 polygons were available in this Istanbul cohort.
Fatih changed from 47-zone Standard to 33-zone Organic because the Standard final realism gate rejected 37.0% following against 80.3% corridor opportunity; Organic follows 66.4%.
Machine quality PASS does not override a visual QA FAIL.
Istanbul is not merge-ready; national rc.3 publish-ready build was not started because the prerequisite Istanbul cohort is not green.
